kind: Agent Canvas frontend/controller and local service launcher

runtime.execution: React/browser controller plus Node service launcher; coding/model turns delegated to separately distributed Python agent server and automation services
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes local/remote/cloud conversation backends through TypeScript client; launcher provisions its own local stack. Agent SDK/server source is not in this snapshot.

summary: Current OpenHands repository is Agent Canvas 1.24.0, a multi-backend coding-agent/automation controller, not the older Python coding engine. Actual browser child-launch mediation exposes admission versus completion and authority boundaries.

inspection.scope: Read current README/package/default pins, launcher command construction/process utilities, actual child-launch WebSocket wiring/local/cloud/control/result/dedup paths, conversation file/send/condense/fork/model APIs, automation dispatch/cancel and independent mock/literal source-test oracles.
inspection.limits: No reference execution/install. Unvendored agent SDK/server/automation backend and TypeScript client implementation not audited; kernel/provider/turn/audit guarantees cannot be inferred from frontend requests. Full desktop/extension/event caching pipeline not exhaustively inspected.

actions.name: launch_child_conversation
actions.input: model ActionEvent task, local/cloud target, workspace/isolation/title/repository
actions.output: backend conversation/start-task ID, URL, isolation/parent-link caveats or error guidance
actions.lifecycle: server acknowledgement first; browser async launch then usually posts result; active goal can suppress; dedup is browser-local
actions.authority: model client tool handled by operator browser; selected service credentials

actions.name: sendMessage / createConversation / switchProfile / switchAcpModel
actions.input: conversation and message or profile/model plus selected backend/runtime credentials
actions.output: sent event or backend start task; model-switch response
actions.lifecycle: calls external clients; sent message != consumed input or completed turn
actions.authority: operator/controller API; model launch uses configured service

actions.name: readConversationFile / downloadConversation / forkConversation
actions.input: conversation ID and scoped file/event cursor
actions.output: file/trajectory bytes or local fork ID
actions.lifecycle: backend request; cloud fork rejected; older server fork contract differs
actions.authority: controller API under selected backend credentials

actions.name: condenseConversation
actions.lifecycle: runtime endpoint call; no local implementation of transformation custody

actions.name: create/update/dispatch/cancel automation
actions.input: prompt, repository, event/cron/timezone specification or run ID
actions.lifecycle: scheduler and run lifecycle external; cancel response not observed process settlement

actions.name: agent-canvas / buildAgentServerCommand / signalProcessTree
actions.input: startup mode, local path/Git ref/version and stack process handle
actions.output: server argv/process group or signal status
actions.lifecycle: separate Python distributions launched via uvx; source rebuilt next invocation; no active compiled refit handoff
actions.authority: operator launcher, not ordinary model tool

filesystem.detail: Controller supplies scoped remote file/trajectory downloads and asks backend to create shared/worktree workspace. Actual model edits and tool engine are unvendored.

processes.detail: Launcher builds coherent server install/run argv and process-group options/signals. These are stack lifecycle primitives, not model shell execution or final death proof.

code_actions.detail: code_actions: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

persistent_kernel.detail: persistent_kernel: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

standing_database.detail: standing_database: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

workflow_programming.detail: Automation client can import prompt plus cron/event spec, create/update/dispatch/cancel externally owned runs; scheduler and executable workflow engine are separate distribution.

multi_model.detail: Actual profile/ACP model-switch requests and local/cloud model configuration surfaces exist. Provider execution/switch timing remains server contract.

live_collaboration.detail: Model client tool can launch a child and normally receive a new-message result; sends address remote conversations. Active goal suppresses result, cloud child lacks parent link; no general peer-room transport or observation guarantee established.

concurrent_work.detail: Controller supports independently running backend conversations/automation and child launches. It consumes external concurrency, and launch acknowledgement precedes actual browser/server completion.

steering_interrupt.detail: sendEvent(run=True) and automation cancel requests are concrete controller APIs; actual mid-turn consumption, worker cancellation and provider/effect settlement are in unvendored servers.

turn_redefinition.detail: turn_redefinition: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

compaction.detail: Calls conversation condense endpoint with exact runtime routing; summary strategy and retained original semantics cannot be inferred from client call.

context_repair.detail: Local event-cursor fork and downloaded trajectory supply repair/branching inputs; cloud fork rejected and backend-version behavior differs. No model original reconstruction implementation in this tree.

original_audit.detail: Frontend imports/downloads backend event/trajectory views; child launch ledger only remembers handled IDs and can fail open. No complete original provider/program/transform event capture established by client controller.

audit_query.detail: Controller can download trajectory and branch at selected event ID; authoritative retention/search belongs to the selected backend, not local browser claims.

hot_change.detail: Actual runtime profile and ACP model switch requests; editable SDK launch command picks source on next invocation. Server activation and old-work handling are unavailable, not turn/workflow-conclusion guarantee.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Local editable packages rebuilt on server invocation and controller can reconnect to independently hosted conversations. No independently powered compile outpost/main settlement/paused work/reinhabitation protocol traced.

remote_services.detail: Routes local and cloud conversation requests, resolves per-conversation runtime URL/session key, launches cloud child and consumes automation service. Boundaries and credentials are explicitly selected; underlying provider execution not audited.

self_improvement.detail: self_improvement: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

complaints.detail: complaints: not established beyond the inspected browser/controller/launcher/client operations; server implementation is separate and unavailable in this snapshot.

authority.detail: Browser controller invokes model-requested child with operator-selected backend/settings and workspace; launcher describes full-access local server. This does not establish model shell approval policy in separate engine.

evaluation.detail: Literal routing/request/result witnesses plus real argv passthrough test; child/worktree/condense endpoints mocked, so no engine correctness, isolation, compaction or process-tree settlement conformance.

time_order.detail: Cloud poll uses Date.now deadline; browser call-ID dedup precedes work and proceeds if storage fails; separate event-cursor fork contract. No durable cross-client causal settlement identity.

evidence.claim: Current role is Agent Canvas across local/remote/cloud backends; local agent-server separately installed, filesystem authority described in setup.
Agent Canvas version/core JS module, external TypeScript client dependency; not embedded coding engine.
Separate agent-server/automation pins, version compatibility and state-path settings.
Imports production static stack launcher after mode/build checks; runtime server loaded separately.
uvx command selects local editable SDK workspace, Git ref, explicit or default server version; coherent SDK/tools/workspace versions; local source rebuilt on invocation.
Explicit running status distinguishes sent signal from actual child exit; service spawn bypasses shell and POSIX new process group.
Group signal/direct fallback returns signalling status; this helper does not wait for effect settlement.
Model client-tool ActionEvent actually dispatches browser child-launch handler; server has already acknowledged before browser work.
Browser localStorage claims tool ID before work; corrupt/full storage proceeds with replay risk rather than blocking launch.
Requests child in parent workspace; worktree failure retries shared workspace; reports isolation downgrade and best-effort title/parent compatibility.
Cloud start polling uses wall-clock deadline and returns latest state even without final conversation ID.
Cloud child request inherits repository/settings but deliberately no server parent link; launched result can contain pending start_task_id/null conversation URL.
Actual result normally posted as new user message; active goal suppresses it to avoid ending loop; errors are caught because server already acknowledged success.
Resolves cloud runtime URL/session key then sends event with run=True via external client; returns sent message, not model completion.
Client reads confined conversation file path/downloads trajectory from selected backend; server effect/file implementation external.
Calls selected runtime condense endpoint; rejects missing cloud runtime URL; no local summary/original-retention engine.
Requests local event-cursor fork and copies client metadata; cloud rejected, older server contract copies full history.
Profile/model switch requests sent to server; local new usage identity avoids old registry entry, ACP model switching delegated to server.
Maps event/cron trigger and imported prompt into automation request; timezone/default timestamp identities.
Automation creation routed through pinned cloud/local backend client; external service owns execution.
Dispatch/cancel requests return external service run representation, not direct OS lifecycle proof.
Mock API oracle checks requested parent worktree and exact returned child ID/status/workspace result.
Mock worktree failure requires shared retry and explicit isolation downgrade in model-visible result.
Repeated tool ID does not launch twice; active goal starts child but no result posted. Storage failure and cross-tab races not covered.
Mock client oracle checks direct cloud runtime URL/session key and missing-URL failure; no summary fidelity/original retention oracle.
Sent signal with unexited child remains running; actual spawned Node returns literal metacharacter argument; no descendant shutdown test here.

tests.focus: Real browser bridge wiring with mocked backend operations
tests.oracle: Literal child request/results, worktree failure shared fallback disclosure, repeated call ID one launch, active goal no result message. Does not witness actual worktree isolation, failed localStorage or cross-tab duplicate admission.
Mocked ConversationClient called with runtime URL/key; missing URL fails without request. No compaction outcome or original reconstruction oracle.

tests.focus: Signal receipt versus child exit and shell-free argument transport
tests.oracle: Literal unexited process remains running even killed=true; actual Node child emits exact argument containing < and exits zero. No descendants/reaping/service effect witness.

strengths: Explicit separation between controller and independently hosted agent backends.
Actual model/browser child launch includes isolation downgrade and parent-link caveats.
Process utility/test distinguishes successfully signalling from actual process exit.
limits: Current snapshot omits coding SDK/server implementation; cannot audit native provider/tools/kernel here.
Browser tool acknowledgement occurs before action; goal-mode result suppression and storage fail-open affect delivery/replay.
Remote start polling can return pending state; no complete original audit/refit promise.
arconaut_questions: An outpost/colleague controller must distinguish admitted launch, running identity, result and settled work.
Browser focus/reload/goal policy must not silently revoke model delivery custody.
Keep consumed shared service/governance separate; study the actual software-agent SDK separately before assigning engine capabilities.
